A 类线性最好效率最低，AB 类折中，C 类高效但仅限 FM / CW。: Class A has the best linearity and the lowest efficiency, class AB is the compromise, and class C is efficient but limited to FM / CW.
PA，把低功率射频信号放大到发射所需功率的末级放大器。: PA: the final amplifier that raises a low-power RF signal to the power needed for transmission.
SSB / 数字模式要求功放线性好，避免频谱扩展干扰邻道。: SSB and digital modes require good amplifier linearity, to avoid spectral splatter interfering with adjacent channels.
功放散热与电源供电要充足，长时间大功率工作需留余量。: Provide adequate heatsinking and supply capacity for the amplifier, with headroom for long periods of high-power operation.
增益比线性值下降 1dB 时的输出功率，标志线性工作上限。: The output power at which the gain falls 1 dB below its linear value, marking the upper limit of linear operation.
多信号输入产生的交调产物，衡量线性度，IMD3 越小越好。: Intermodulation products generated when several signals are applied; a measure of linearity — the lower IMD3, the better.
导通半个周期，理论效率上限 π/4 ≈ 78.5%；存在交越失真，推挽使用。: Conducts for half the cycle, with a theoretical efficiency limit of π/4 ≈ 78.5%; it has crossover distortion and is used in push-pull.
导通角介于 A 与 B 之间，线性与效率折中，是 SSB 线性功放的主流。: The conduction angle lies between class A and class B, a compromise between linearity and efficiency; the mainstream choice for SSB linear amplifiers.
导通角小于半周，效率最高但失真大，只能用于 FM / CW 等恒包络信号。: The conduction angle is less than half a cycle; highest efficiency but heavy distortion, usable only with constant-envelope signals such as FM / CW.
开关类（器件工作在饱和/截止），靠谐振网络整形输出；用于高效率发射机与开关电源。: Switching classes (the device works in saturation / cut-off), with a resonant network shaping the output; used in high-efficiency transmitters and switching supplies.
推动功率不可过大，防止过驱动导致失真与烧毁。: Drive power must not be too high, to prevent overdrive causing distortion and burn-out.
整个周期导通，线性最好、失真最小；阻性负载与 RC 耦合理论上限约 25%，变压: Conducts over the whole cycle, with the best linearity and lowest distortion; the theoretical limit is about 25% with a resistive load and RC coupling, and up to 50% with transformer (inductive) coupling. Runs hot, so it suits only low power and linear stages.
输出与输入功率之比（dB），表示放大能力。: The ratio of output to input power (dB), expressing the amplification capability.
驻波过高会损坏功放，须配驻波保护或先调好天线。: Excessive SWR can damage the amplifier, so fit SWR protection or tune the antenna first.
